builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary_en: Founder retrospectives that document regrets and lessons can spare others costly mistakes. A metric suggesting exceptional AI progress this year prompts skepticism about whether benchmark gains reflect broader improvements.

slang.definition_en: Slang for being in trouble, overwhelmed, or badly misled.

builders.name: Nan Yu
builders.summary_en: Jokes that the secret to making AI-generated projects more scalable, performant, and reliable is choosing Postgres.

I found a secret prompt that makes all your vibecoded projects scale and perform better, with higher reliability.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary_en: Argues that desktop AI apps pose substantial security and privacy risks, and says Replit worked with Windows on a stronger security model for its desktop app. Cites Christie’s adoption as evidence of customer confidence.
builders.summary_zh: 他认为桌面 AI 应用存在较大的安全和隐私风险，并称 Replit 与 Windows 合作为桌面应用建立了更强的安全机制。他以佳士得的采用说明客户对该方案的信任。

slang.definition_en: Release a product or feature for people to use.

keywords.definition_zh: 在科技行业中指把产品或功能正式交付上线。
keywords.example_zh: 作者说与 Windows 合作，为 Replit Desktop 交付了一套安全模型。

keywords.definition_zh: 指规定系统如何管理权限、隔离操作和保护资源的安全机制。
keywords.example_zh: 作者认为桌面 AI 应用存在安全与隐私风险，并以 Replit Desktop 的安全模型作为回应。

Which is why Christie’s, the world’s preeminent custodian of rare art, chose Replit for secure agentic work! https://t.co/58YGxzHp1o

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary_en: Argues that AI breakthroughs should produce explanations, concepts, and walkthroughs humans can understand, using a hypothetical Riemann proof as an example. Also questions the trustworthiness of anonymous models offering free inference with zero-data-retention claims.
builders.summary_zh: 他主张 AI 突破应同时带来人类能理解的解释、概念和推导过程，并以假设中的黎曼猜想证明为例。他也质疑匿名模型提供免费推理并宣称零数据保留是否值得信任。

slang.definition_en: Running a trained AI model to produce an output.
slang.definition_zh: 运行已训练的 AI 模型以生成输出。

slang.definition_en: A model offered without openly identifying its origin or full details.
slang.definition_zh: 未公开来源或完整信息便对外提供的模型。

slang.definition_en: Zero data retention: a claim or policy that submitted data is not retained.
slang.definition_zh: 零数据保留，指不留存所提交数据的声明或政策。

keywords.definition_zh: 指编译过程中连接源代码与目标代码的中间表示形式。
keywords.example_zh: 作者借用编译器概念作类比，主张 AI 的成果也应提供便于人类理解的解释层。

keywords.definition_zh: 在 AI 中指运行已训练模型来生成预测或输出的过程。
keywords.example_zh: 作者质疑某服务商提供免费模型推理的宣传，提醒读者审视背后的可信度与数据处理方式。

keywords.definition_zh: Zero Data Retention 的缩写，指零数据保留。
keywords.example_zh: 作者对匿名模型服务宣称的「零数据保留」持怀疑态度；推文没有证实该承诺是否兑现。

tweets.text:
Rather than art, we ought to point AI towards human-understandability and conceptualization.

The Riemann proof should come with a paper, a walkthrough, new concepts and insights.

Much like the intermediate representation of high-level code is desirable even in a world where LLM will go straight to CPU instructions output.

This aged extremely well.

There's a tweet out there (will likely get deleted soon) of a provider giving you "free" inference of a "stealth model" that's "ZDR" with millions of views.

These stealth models are mechanisms of industrial scale data exfiltration to nation state programs, I strongly suspect, and the Dragos research seems to confirm.

Imagine explaining to your boss: sorry chief, I *had* to try this really cool ZDR free stealth model… all our secrets, customer data, and code are now in a different continent!

Vercel AI Gateway built up tremendous, real-world token volume without taking any of these shortcuts. More to come tomorrow on how we will push the trust, privacy, and security bar even higher.
tweets.summary_en: Free inference from unnamed “stealth models” may expose sensitive company data despite zero-data-retention claims; the tweet alleges possible nation-state data collection, citing Dragos research as support. It contrasts those suspected risks with Vercel AI Gateway’s approach to trust, privacy, and security.

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.summary_en: Long-running AI projects and groups of agents working in parallel will require more capable orchestration architectures and agent execution infrastructure.
builders.summary_zh: 随着 AI 承担长时间运行的项目，并由多个智能体并行推进目标，协调架构和智能体执行基础设施都需要进一步发展。

slang.definition_en: The surrounding software that manages an agent’s execution, tools, context, and controls.
slang.definition_zh: 管理智能体执行、工具、上下文和控制机制的外围软件。

slang.definition_en: Groups of AI agents coordinating or dividing work toward a shared goal.
slang.definition_zh: 围绕共同目标协作或分工的一组 AI 智能体。

slang.definition_en: Coordinating tasks, dependencies, and execution across agents or systems.
slang.definition_zh: 协调多个智能体或系统之间的任务、依赖关系与执行过程。

keywords.definition_zh: 指多个 AI 智能体组成并协同完成任务的群体。
keywords.example_zh: 作者设想多个智能体围绕同一个目标并行工作，从而对底层架构提出更高要求。

keywords.definition_zh: 指支撑智能体运行、调用工具和管理执行过程的软件框架。
keywords.example_zh: 随着智能体承担更长时间的项目工作，作者认为管理其执行过程的框架也必须升级。

keywords.definition_zh: 指对多个任务、工具或智能体进行协调和调度。
keywords.example_zh: 这里强调，当多个智能体并行推进项目时，需要更强的机制来协调分工与执行。

tweets.text:
Yes to all of this. As agents take on more and more long running project work, and you have swarms of agents that parallelize work against a goal, the agent harness and architecture for orchestration will have to evolve. 

One of the biggest shifts is how those agents collectively share their knowledge, keep track of the tasks, and also coordinate with human users. This in theory is technically straightforward, but there’s a ton of complexity to get right to ensure agents can both get access to the revenant resources without too much or little exposure.

There are a lot of lessons to pull from based on how people already do this kind of work together (people share their files, have computers to work with, community in chats and inboxes, and so on). But equally the primitives need to be able to enable this work at a throughput far higher than people, and in a world where agents can much more easily become a vector of security risk. 

Going to be super fun building out this next generation of how agents operate. Lots of opportunity here both for horizontal and vertical specific approaches to bring this to life.
tweets.summary_en: Long-running projects and parallel agent teams need better orchestration for sharing knowledge, tracking tasks, and coordinating with humans. These systems can borrow from human collaboration tools but must support much higher throughput while carefully controlling resource access and security risks.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary_en: Warns that an incident, if caused by an AI-assisted cyberattack, could expose a serious gap in aviation security measures designed around human hijackers. The excerpt does not establish the incident’s cause.
builders.summary_zh: 他警告，某起事件如果由 AI 辅助网络攻击引发，可能暴露出针对人类劫机者设计的航空安保措施中的严重缺口。片段并未证实事件原因。

keywords.definition_zh: 指利用 AI 辅助策划或执行的网络攻击。
keywords.example_zh: 作者以事件由 AI 辅助网络攻击造成这一假设为前提，担忧航空安全措施可能受到冲击；推文没有确认事件原因。

keywords.definition_zh: 指容易夸大危险、制造恐慌的人。
keywords.example_zh: 作者先声明自己通常不会夸大风险，再表达对这一假设情形的强烈担忧。

tweets.text:
i am usually not alarmist but assuming this is caused by an AI-assisted cyber attack it's very bad

if you want to make all of the security measures we have in place from 9/11 onward to prevent human hijackers irrelevant all you have to do is be able to mess with a plane and pilot's ability to know its own weight, how much fuel is left, and where it is

without knowing any more information about this, you'd also expect smaller attakcs like this to find edges and what's possible

i am not an expert on the systems inside airplanes, and i know most planes have manual overrides for example. but still extremely tricky when visibility is bad 

if you know more than me about this please weigh in!
tweets.summary_en: If the unspecified aviation incident involved an AI-assisted cyberattack, it could reveal serious risks from manipulating aircraft weight, fuel, or location information, potentially bypassing protections focused on human hijackers. The concern is explicitly speculative, with uncertainty about aircraft systems and the effectiveness of manual overrides.

builders.name: Sam Altman
builders.summary_en: Says AI labs committed under White House accords to develop safety standards and best practices, and suggests discussing perplexity could support those goals. A separate correction lacks enough context to clarify the intended wording.
builders.summary_zh: 他称 AI 实验室已在白宫相关协议下承诺制定安全标准和最佳实践，并提出讨论 perplexity 可能有助于实现这些目标。另一条更正缺乏上下文，无法确定其具体所指。

keywords.definition_zh: 在语言模型领域通常指衡量模型对文本预测不确定程度的困惑度指标。
keywords.example_zh: 作者认为讨论 perplexity 的使用有助于推进系统安全目标，但所给片段没有解释其具体用途。

keywords.definition_zh: 指某一领域广泛认可、值得遵循的有效做法。
keywords.example_zh: 作者说实验室同意制定标准和最佳实践，以提高 AI 系统的安全性。

tweets.text: Labs agreed under the White House Accords to establish standards and best practices to improve the safety of their systems, and I believe a discussion about the use of perplexity can further these goals.

podcasts.name: AI & I by Every
podcasts.title: A New Vision for Human Work After Automation
podcasts.summary_en: The introduction frames everyday AI use by writers and builders as a way to understand changing capabilities and practical workflows, then introduces Every’s first conference in Brooklyn. The excerpt ends before any substantive talks or findings are presented.
podcasts.summary_zh: 开场提出，通过写作者和构建者日常使用 AI 的经验，可以了解能力变化及实用工作方法，随后介绍了 Every 在布鲁克林举办的首场大会。片段在具体演讲内容和结论出现之前结束。

vocab.definition_en: The purchase of one company by another.
vocab.definition_zh: 收购；一家公司购买另一家公司。
vocab.example_en: The founders resolved several legal issues before the acquisition.
vocab.example_zh: 创始人在收购完成前解决了几个法律问题。

vocab.definition_en: A measure of how well a probabilistic model predicts data; lower values indicate better prediction on the evaluated data.
vocab.definition_zh: 困惑度；衡量概率模型预测数据表现的指标，在所评估的数据上，数值越低表示预测越好。
vocab.example_en: Lower perplexity does not automatically mean better performance on every practical task.
vocab.example_zh: 困惑度更低，并不自动意味着模型在每一项实际任务上都表现更好。

vocab.definition_en: A standard or test used to compare performance.
vocab.definition_zh: 基准；用于比较表现的标准或测试。
vocab.example_en: A useful benchmark should reflect the tasks users actually care about.
vocab.example_zh: 有用的基准测试应该反映用户真正关心的任务。

vocab.definition_en: To estimate beyond known observations by extending an existing pattern.
vocab.definition_zh: 外推；根据已有的观察或趋势推测未知情况。
vocab.example_en: It is risky to extrapolate years of progress from a few recent results.
vocab.example_zh: 仅凭最近几次结果就外推未来数年的进展，存在风险。

vocab.definition_en: Causing a major change in how something works or develops.
vocab.definition_zh: 具有变革性的；能使事物的运作或发展发生重大变化的。
vocab.example_en: Reliable agents could have a transformative effect on software design.
vocab.example_zh: 可靠的智能体可能对软件设计产生变革性影响。

vocab.definition_en: An obstacle that prevents or delays progress.
vocab.definition_zh: 障碍；阻止或拖慢进展的问题。
vocab.example_en: Unclear ownership of the code became a roadblock to the deal.
vocab.example_zh: 代码归属不明确成了这笔交易的障碍。

vocab.definition_en: The ability to work correctly and consistently over time.
vocab.definition_zh: 可靠性；长期正确、稳定运行的能力。
vocab.example_en: Agents may prioritize reliability over a visually attractive interface.
vocab.example_zh: 智能体可能会优先考虑可靠性，而不是界面是否美观。

quote.text_en: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.

slang_glossary.definition_en: An informal term for family or close friends.

slang_glossary.definition_zh: 发布或上线产品、功能或更新。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Running a trained AI model to produce predictions or outputs.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 推理；运行已训练的 AI 模型以生成预测或输出。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An AI model tested or made available without a clear public announcement or disclosed identity.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 尚未正式公开发布，或未披露真实身份就进行测试或提供使用的 AI 模型。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Zero Data Retention: a policy governing non-retention of covered customer data, with scope depending on the provider.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 零数据保留；不保留政策所涵盖的客户数据，具体适用范围取决于服务商。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The surrounding software that gives an AI agent tools, execution control, and ways to interact with its environment.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 智能体运行框架；为 AI 智能体提供工具、执行控制和环境交互能力的外围软件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Groups of AI agents working on tasks in parallel or in coordination.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 智能体群；并行工作或相互协作的一组 AI 智能体。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Coordinating models, agents, tools, and workflow steps.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 编排；协调模型、智能体、工具和工作流步骤。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Completed successfully in a single attempt or prompt.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 一次搞定；通过一次尝试或一次提示就成功完成。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Venture capitalists or venture capital firms that invest in startups.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 风险投资人或投资初创公司的风投机构。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The valuation at which an investor initially invests in a company.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 入场估值；投资者首次投资一家公司时所依据的估值。

slang_glossary.definition_en: At a startup stage before a usable product has been built or launched.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 尚未做出或推出可用产品的创业阶段。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An unsolicited outreach email to someone with whom the sender has no prior relationship.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 陌生开发邮件；向此前没有联系的人主动发送的邮件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Software as a Service: software delivered as an online service, commonly through subscriptions.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 软件即服务；通过在线服务提供软件，通常采用订阅付费方式。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The legal transfer of ownership of intellectual property.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 知识产权转让；依法将知识产权的所有权转移给另一方。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Search Engine Optimization: improving a website's visibility in unpaid search results.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 搜索引擎优化；提高网站在自然搜索结果中的可见度。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Chief Technology Officer: an executive responsible for a company's technology direction.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 首席技术官；负责公司技术方向的高管。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An adviser who helps technology leaders develop management, leadership, and strategic skills.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 首席技术官教练；帮助技术负责人提升管理、领导和战略能力的顾问。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To seek potential buyers or signal interest in having one's company acquired.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 寻找收购机会；试探潜在买家，或释放愿意出售公司的信号。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Floating-point operations per second, a measure of computing speed; total training compute is usually expressed in FLOPs.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 每秒浮点运算次数，用于衡量计算速度；训练总计算量通常用「FLOPs」表示。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A prediction metric for probabilistic models, often used to evaluate language models.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 困惑度；概率模型的预测评价指标，常用于评估语言模型。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The logarithm of perplexity; its numerical interpretation depends on the logarithm base and evaluation setup.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对数困惑度；对困惑度取对数后的值，其数值含义取决于对数底数和评估设置。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Representing data more compactly; in language modeling, better prediction is closely connected to better compression.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 压缩；以更紧凑的方式表示数据。在语言建模中，更好的预测与更好的压缩密切相关。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Very advanced mathematical problems near the limits of current capabilities; it may also allude to the FrontierMath benchmark.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 接近当前能力边界的高难度数学问题；也可能是在影射「FrontierMath」数学基准测试。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Training after pretraining to refine a model's behavior or capabilities.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 后训练；在预训练之后进一步调整模型行为或能力的训练。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To perform a model's initial large-scale training; also used informally to refer to pretraining.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 预训练；对模型进行初始的大规模训练，也可作为预训练过程的非正式简称。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The main storyline and a secondary storyline, used metaphorically to rank developments by importance.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 主线剧情与支线剧情；此处用来比喻不同技术进展的重要程度。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An AI system that can take actions, often using tools, to pursue a goal.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 智能体；能够采取行动、通常借助工具来完成目标的 AI 系统。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Application Programming Interface: a defined way for software systems to communicate.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 应用程序编程接口；软件系统之间按约定进行通信的方式。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Executive Vice President, a senior corporate leadership title.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 执行副总裁；企业高级管理职位。
